sentences.text: In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
The dataset was split into 70 percent training data and the rest for testing.
All experiments were run on a single GPU with 24 GB of memory.
Figure 1 shows the test accuracy of BERT-base by dataset.
BERT-base scores 25.1 points higher on IMDB than on SVHN.
On IMDB, BERT-base obtains a test accuracy of 71.0% (Figure 1).
BERT-base achieves 83.0% test accuracy on MNIST.
BERT-base reaches 35.0% test accuracy on AG News (Figure 1).
Figure 2 shows the validation accuracy during training.
At epoch 22, DistilBERT achieves 78.4% validation accuracy.
At epoch 30, Transformer is about 18 points better than BERT-base.
LSTM outperforms MobileNet by 11 percentage points at epoch 24 (Figure 2).
On IMDB, Naive Bayes obtains an accuracy of 61.4%.
We note that the training was stable for all models.
